 BK Häcken travelling squad confirmed 
 Man City Editorial 
 Tue 17 Nov 2026, 13:15 
 Share 
 Manchester City's travelling squad for our UEFA Women's Champions League clash with BK Häcken has been confirmed. 
 The Blues travel to Gothenburg on Wednesday 18 November, with kick-off set for 17:45 (UK).
 City currently sit sixth in the League Phase table, two points and two places off an automatic qualification spot for the knockout stages with two matches left.
 The hosts, meanwhile, are 15th but did pick up a hard-earned point against Chelsea in their most recent European fixture.
 Ahead of our latest UEFA Women’s Champions League clash, you can find our confirmed travelling squad below...
